comment: The four signal inputs are read with getVoltageSum, which loops over the polyphonic channels and adds them, so a polyphonic cable is summed to one mono signal rather than filtered per voice; poly is recorded true on that basis. Resonance is capped at 0.8 of the knob plus 0.9 of the CV and clamped to 0.9, which the maker's comment calls about 80% of the Ripples model it is built on. The frequency knobs run from 20Hz to 20kHz, the Ripples constants kFreqKnobMin and kFreqKnobMax. The HP tap is a 2-pole and is halved in level before the output; LP and BP are 4-pole. Three debug menu items — gain compensation, add lowend to HP, and a circuit-based filter simulation — are commented out in the widget and are not reachable.
